name: Haughty Obstinacy
description: Your pride shrugs off those who would rule you: +1 to Will saves.

name: Cooperative Nature
description: You have learned to get along: +2 to Diplomacy checks.

name: Road-Hardened
description: Years on Vardmoor's roads have toughened you: +1 HP per level.

name: Clever Improviser
description: You make do: +1 to checks with skills you are untrained in.

name: Stonecunning
description: You read stone and shadow: +1 to Perception.

name: Dwarven Toughness
description: Dwarven stubbornness keeps you standing: +1 HP per level.

name: Rock Runner
description: Sure-footed on any ground: +1 to Reflex saves.

name: Unburdened Iron
description: You were made for armour: body armour never slows you.

name: Nimble Elf
description: Light on your feet: +5 ft speed.

name: Elven Instincts
description: Nothing escapes your notice: +1 to Perception.

name: Elven Lore
description: You were taught the old names: +2 to Arcana and Nature checks.

name: Unwavering Mien
description: Your mind is your own: +1 to Will saves.

name: Bloody Blows
description: Your strikes leave deep wounds: +2 damage on a critical hit.

name: Orc Ferocity
description: You fight on through pain: +1 HP per level.

name: Orc Superstition
description: Old charms guard your mind: +1 to Will saves.

name: Menacing Presence
description: You know how to loom: +2 to Intimidation checks.

name: Sure Feet
description: You never lose your footing: +1 to Reflex saves and +2 to Acrobatics checks.

name: Halfling Luck
description: Luck runs in your family: +1 to Fortitude saves.

name: Keen Eyes
description: Small folk see what big folk miss: +1 to Perception.

name: Unfettered Halfling
description: Nothing holds you for long: +5 ft speed.

name: Cinder Skin
description: The god's ash lives in your skin: fire resistance 2.

name: Taint Eater
description: Your blood is used to the Taint: it builds a quarter more slowly in you.

name: Ember Sight
description: Your eyes catch a glow others can't: +1 to Perception.

name: Ash Walker
description: You move like drifting ash: +5 ft speed.

name: Intimidating Strike
description: A new ability: Strike, and on a hit the target is frightened 1 (2 on a critical hit). 10 Fury.

name: Brutish Shove
description: A new ability: Strike, and on a hit knock the target back 1.5 tiles and leave it off-guard for 2 s. 10 Fury.

name: Lunge
description: You strike from further off: +1 tile of melee reach.

name: Knockdown
description: A new ability: Strike, and on a hit knock the target prone for 1.5 s. 20 Fury, 6 s cooldown.

name: Swipe
description: A new ability: one swing that strikes the target and one more enemy within reach. 15 Fury.

name: Furious Focus
description: Battle feeds you: +4 Fury on every hit.

name: Reach Spell
description: Your spells carry further: +3 tiles of spell range.

name: Cantrip Expansion: Electric Arc
description: A new cantrip: an arc of lightning that leaps to a second enemy.

name: Cantrip Expansion: Ray of Frost
description: A new cantrip: a ray of cold that slows its target.

name: Force Volley
description: Force Bolt looses one more missile.

name: Linked Focus
description: Your Mana regenerates a quarter faster.

name: Arcane Ward
description: A standing ward: +1 to AC.

name: Toughness
description: You can take more punishment: +1 HP per level.

name: Fleet
description: You move more quickly: +5 ft speed.

name: Canny Acumen
description: Your mind is hard to sway: +2 to Will saves.

name: Incredible Recovery
description: You catch your breath quickly: out-of-combat recovery is half as fast again.

name: Sense the Dead
description: You feel the restless dead: +2 to Religion checks and +1 to Perception.

name: Hardy Recovery
description: You've marched on worse: out-of-combat recovery is a quarter faster, and +2 to Athletics checks.

name: Recall Lore
description: You remember what you read: +2 to all Lore checks.

name: Quick Lockpick
description: Locks don't slow you: +2 to Thievery checks.

name: Shrine Ward
description: The Lantern's rites steady you: +1 to Will saves and +2 to Religion checks.

name: Track Prey
description: You read signs in mud and grass: +2 to Survival checks and +1 to Perception.

name: Pickpocket
description: Light fingers: +2 to Thievery and Stealth checks.

name: Silver Tongue
description: You talk your way through: +2 to Diplomacy and Deception checks.

name: Cat Fall
description: You land well and dodge better: +1 to Reflex saves and +2 to Acrobatics checks.

name: Recognize Spell
description: You know a spell when you see one: +2 to Arcana checks and +1 to Will saves.

name: Battle Medicine
description: You patch yourself up between fights: out-of-combat recovery is half as fast again.

name: Intimidating Glare
description: A look is enough: +2 to Intimidation checks.

name: Lie to Me
description: You know a lie when you hear one: +2 to Deception checks and +1 to Perception.

name: Quick Repair
description: You can mend most things: +2 to Crafting checks.

name: Natural Medicine
description: You know the healing herbs: +2 to Nature checks, and out-of-combat recovery is a quarter faster.

name: Oddity Identification
description: You spot the uncanny: +2 to Occultism checks and +1 to Will saves.

name: Terrain Stalker
description: You move unseen: +2 to Stealth checks.

name: Streetwise
description: You know how towns work: +2 to Society and Diplomacy checks.

name: Fascinating Performance
description: You hold a crowd: +2 to Performance checks.

name: Titan Wrestler
description: You can grapple anything: +2 to Athletics checks and +1 to Fortitude saves.

name: Student of the Canon
description: You know the Lantern's texts: +2 to Religion checks.

name: Experienced Tracker
description: No trail is cold to you: +2 to Survival checks.

name: Breaker of Embers
description: You smashed Sallow's Cinder Relic. +1 to Will saves, and the Taint builds in you a quarter more slowly.

name: Ward of the Lantern
description: Brother Anselm's blessing. Resistance 2 to void, and the Taint builds in you a quarter more slowly.

name: The Scarecrow's Peace
description: The spirit you freed keeps watch with you. +1 to Perception, and you move 5 feet faster.
